subject: Logan Airport Flight Pattern Noise Complaints
overview: The Council addressed resident grievances regarding excessive aircraft noise from Logan Airport and discussed the deteriorating state of the public library. Members also debated mitigation strategies for businesses impacted by the Cradock Bridge reconstruction and debated the process for a potential city charter review.

items.title: Logan Airport Flight Noise Resolution
items.summary: Passed a resolution requesting reports on flight patterns and noise levels from Massport and the FAA, and invited airport officials to address the Council regarding resident grievances. Residents and councilors testified that low-flying aircraft are causing significant sleep disruption and decreased quality of life across the city.

items.title: Parking Kiosk Impacts in Medford Square
items.summary: Discussed the negative impact of parking kiosks on local businesses and forwarded a petition with 337 signatures opposing the system to the Traffic Commission.

items.title: Public Hearing: Riverside Avenue Pole Relocation
items.summary: Approved a petition from National Grid to relocate a utility pole on Riverside Avenue, with an amendment requiring the contractor to strictly adhere to city debris removal regulations.

items.title: Library Bathroom Maintenance and Funding
items.summary: Requested a detailed accounting of previously allocated funds for library bathroom repairs following reports that facilities remain in deplorable condition. Councilors debated the chronic underfunding of the library and the risk of losing state certification.

items.title: Cradock Bridge Construction and Business Mitigation
items.summary: Debated the lack of communication from the Department of Transportation regarding the three-year Cradock Bridge project and requested a meeting to discuss traffic flow and mitigation for affected businesses.

items.title: Police and Fire Facility Needs
items.summary: Received testimony regarding the urgent need to prioritize a new police and fire headquarters to replace the outdated facility built in the 1960s.

items.title: Lawrence Memorial Hospital Future Affiliate Proposal
items.summary: Approved a resolution suggesting that Hallmark Health utilize vacant floors at Lawrence Memorial Hospital for private medical practices to facilitate a potential affiliation with Partners HealthCare.

items.title: Charter Review Process Discussion
items.summary: Discussed the legal process for initiating a city charter review before the resolution was withdrawn to be placed on the upcoming regular agenda for further public participation.

items.title: Budget Hearings and Administrative Matters
items.summary: Announced the schedule for fiscal year 2016 budget hearings, approved minutes from the previous meeting, and memorialized deceased police department members.
